fantasy: Sit in the cockpit of a giant machine and operate it
craving: The childhood wish to climb into an excavator at the park and command heavy machinery—see every lever do something immediately and master the controls.
target_audience: Players who enjoy simulation and heavy-paced incremental games
mechanics: Pulling levers and flipping switches inside the cockpit
Selling power surges to the grid to fund upgrades

inspirations.borrowed: Machine purpose is clear just by looking at it
inspirations.my_context: Instead of farm equipment, a fictional artillery-style rig where every lever visibly moves a part
Single currency called 'energy credits'; every upgrade spends it directly with no crafting

inspirations.borrowed: Mission structure and between-run part slotting loop
inspirations.my_context: Cockpit circuit cards instead of mech parts; balancing power draw instead of weight
Zero overlay menus; every setting is a physical toggle or dial mounted in the cockpit
